driving_styles.name: Smooth
driving_styles.description: Prioritizes textbook geometric racing lines, gentle steering inputs, and momentum preservation. Minimizes unnecessary tire scrub to maintain high corner-exit speeds.
tactical_traits: Clips apex kerbs with millimeter accuracy.
Executes trail-braking smoothly to maintain vehicle pitch balance.
Rarely makes unforced slide errors; patient when trailing.

driving_styles.name: Aggressive
driving_styles.description: Fearless wheel-to-wheel combatant who brakes at the absolute threshold, divebombs into braking zones, and forces opponents to compromise their line.
tactical_traits: Late-brakes deep into hairpins and chicanes.
Uses curb bounces and track verges aggressively.
Higher risk of lockups and corner-exit snap oversteer under pressure.

driving_styles.name: Tenacious
driving_styles.description: Ironclad defensive specialist who positions their vehicle as wide as the track, fiercely protecting the inside line and frustrating overtake attempts.
tactical_traits: Anticipates opponent moves and covers the apex early.
Exceptional composure when under intense rear bumper pressure.
Relentless lap-time consistency over long championship stints.

driving_styles.name: Calculating
driving_styles.description: Telemetry-minded tactician who studies opponent delta splits, avoids low-percentage lunges, and ruthlessly capitalizes on mistakes ahead.
tactical_traits: Optimizes slip angles for maximum straight-line exit velocity.
Capitalizes on competitor contact and errors instantly.
Maintains disciplined tire wear and temperature management.

driving_styles.name: Bold
driving_styles.description: Audacious cross-discipline daredevil known for spectacular overtakes around the outside, Scandinavian flicks, and high-slip angle car control.
tactical_traits: Willing to attempt passes where other drivers hesitate.
High slip-angle tolerance with lightning counter-steer reflexes.
Thrives on loose surfaces, dirt ruts, and jump landings.

driving_styles.name: Balanced
driving_styles.description: Well-rounded clubman racer blending solid single-lap pace, steady racecraft, clean overtakes, and dependable defensive awareness.
tactical_traits: Adaptable to varying track conditions and modalities.
Dependable performance across diverse performance tiers.

mistake_kinds.name: Late Braking Lockup
mistake_kinds.description: Over-estimates the car's braking threshold by 30–60% and enters the braking zone carrying excessive velocity, missing the turn-in point.
mistake_kinds.trigger_condition: High pressure from pursuing cars or aggressive overtake attempts.
mistake_kinds.gameplay_impact: Runs deep past the apex, leaving the door wide open for an undercut pass.
mistake_kinds.recovery_behavior: Applies maximum steering angle and trail brakes hard to scrub speed.

mistake_kinds.name: Corner Overdrive
mistake_kinds.description: Enters the corner 8–25% above the tire grip limit, inducing understeer and washing out toward the track verge.
mistake_kinds.trigger_condition: Carrying too much apex momentum in fast sweepers.
mistake_kinds.gameplay_impact: Washes wide onto dirty track surfaces, grass, or curbs, losing exit speed.
mistake_kinds.recovery_behavior: Lifts off the throttle abruptly and counter-steers to re-establish front grip.

mistake_kinds.name: Power Oversteer Snap
mistake_kinds.description: Applies full throttle and handbrake simultaneously on corner exit for 0.6–1.1s, overpowering the rear tires and snapping into an oversteer slide.
mistake_kinds.trigger_condition: Low-gear corner exits under heavy acceleration.
mistake_kinds.gameplay_impact: Violent rear slide that burns rear tire temperature and costs straight-line speed.
mistake_kinds.recovery_behavior: Counter-steers hard to catch the slide before it transitions into a 360-degree spin.

mistake_kinds.name: Steering Over-Correction
mistake_kinds.description: Over-reacts to a minor lateral wiggle with 1.6x steering gain for 0.5s, inducing secondary tank-slapper oscillations.
mistake_kinds.trigger_condition: Kerb strikes or surface transitions that perturb chassis roll.
mistake_kinds.gameplay_impact: Erratic slalom weaving that slows the vehicle and destabilizes platform balance.
mistake_kinds.recovery_behavior: Rapidly relaxes steering input back to center after 500 ms.

mistake_kinds.name: Hesitation & Early Lift
mistake_kinds.description: Brakes 5–15 meters earlier than necessary or lifts off the throttle prematurely in apex compression.
mistake_kinds.trigger_condition: Low driver composure under pressure or wet/low-grip surfaces.
mistake_kinds.gameplay_impact: Gives away easy momentum to bolder drivers trailing closely behind.
mistake_kinds.recovery_behavior: Smoothly reapplies throttle once confidence in front grip is confirmed.
